# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 20 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Market Pulse: New Sales & Price Trends

- **New private home sales rebounded sharply in July 2026** - Developers sold 731 new private homes (excluding ECs) in July 2026, up 368.6% from June's 156 units, marking the strongest sales month since April as fresh launches returned after an unusually quiet June. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-home-sales-rebound-to-3-month-high-as-july-launches-return/)

- **HDB resale prices fell in Q2 2026 while private condo prices rose** - The HDB resale price index declined in 2Q2026 while private condo prices moved upward, widening the price gap between the two markets. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-prices-are-falling-while-condo-prices-rise-but-upgraders-have-a-bigger-problem/)

## HDB Resale Records

- **Bishan 4-room flat sells for $1.3 million, setting a new town record** - A 14-year-old 4-room flat at Natura Loft, Bishan Street 24, transacted at $1.3 million in August 2026, beating the previous high in the same block by $37,000. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/14-year-old-bishan-4-room-flat-sold-for-record-1-3m/)

- **Clementi Peaks 3-room unit sets new town record at S$896,000** - A unit at Clementi Peaks sold for S$896,000, a new 3-room record for Clementi, in a transaction that occurred before the development reached its Minimum Occupation Period. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/clementi-peaks-first-resale-breaks-3rm-hdb-record-at-s896k/)

## Supply Pipeline: New Sites & Rezoning

- **Kallang Distripark could be rezoned for up to 2,550 private homes** - URA published proposed Master Plan amendments on 14 August 2026 that would rezone the existing Kallang Distripark industrial site to allow up to 2,550 private homes near Geylang Bahru MRT station and the Kallang River. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/kallang-distripark-redevelopment-private-homes/)

- **Two new GLS sites in Marina South and Orchard Boulevard released, adding around 500 homes** - URA released Government Land Sales sites at Marina Gardens Lane (6,007.4 sqm) and Orchard Boulevard (3,438.0 sqm), which could together contribute around 500 private homes to the housing pipeline. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/two-new-gls-sites-released-in-marina-south-and-orchard-boulevard/)
